Author: JustPixelll
Name: All My Glams
Punchline: Your glamour, Glamourer and Penumbra outfit workspace.
Description: Build equipment-only glamour designs, capture and apply looks through Glamourer, keep a local wardrobe and favourites, browse existing Glamourer designs, and manage equipment-affecting Penumbra mods from one UI.
Changelog: Initial experimental release of All My Glams. Includes the equipment dresser, local wardrobe and favourites, Glamourer design integration, Penumbra mod discovery and controls, mod priorities/options, combined gear + mod look recipes, and the sourced-wardrobe foundation.
